name: optimize_js_indexof_frequency_map
description: keys.indexOf(item) per element building a frequency table -> Map; budget calibrated (naive ~3.5s native at n=80k all-distinct vs ~0.01s, budget 2s); wrong-output broken (plain object) reorders numeric-looking keys
prompts: frequency(items) in frequency.js builds a first-occurrence-ordered frequency table by calling keys.indexOf(item) on a growing array for every element - a linear scan per element, O(n^2) overall and far too slow for large inputs. Rewrite it with a Map (insertion-ordered, and safe for any key shape), returning the exact same { keys, counts } shape: keys in first-occurrence order, counts parallel to keys. Do NOT use a plain object as the accumulator - it silently reorders integer-like string keys to numeric order regardless of insertion order, which breaks the first-occurrence contract. Keep the function name, signature, and module.exports.
